# CyteArc

> Out-of-core, provenance-backed single-cell analysis for RNA, ATAC, protein, and matched multi-omic data. This documentation is published from the master branch and covers supported workflows, public APIs, and their limitations.

CyteBase, the catalog of public datasets stored as cloud-hosted CyteArc DataStores, is the separate `cytebase` package; CyteArc opens its datasets by their hf:// URIs. Its documentation is published at https://docs.nygen.io/CyteBase/.

- [Home](./): choose a first example or find a guide for your analysis

## Getting started

- [Quick start](quickstart/): inspect a prepared analysis of 100,000 Tabula Sapiens cells, then run the RNA pipeline recipe
- [Remote dataset mounting](tutorials/remote-stores/): plot the Tabula Sapiens atlas, save a local cell selection, and reopen it while counts stay remote
- [Installation](installation/): supported Python versions and installation paths

## scRNA-seq preprocessing and structure

- [PBMC analysis](tutorials/scrna-seq/): name the PBMC populations of a saved analysis from their marker genes
- [Cell calling](tutorials/cell-calling/): EmptyDrops calls cells in an unfiltered droplet matrix before quality control
- [Ambient RNA removal](tutorials/ambient-rna/): soup profile from empty droplets, contamination from marker gene sets, and corrected counts
- [HTO demultiplexing](tutorials/hto-demultiplexing/): call each droplet's donor from hashtag counts, check the calls against RNA content, compare cutoff quantiles, and select the singlets
- [Quality control](tutorials/quality-control/): compare automatic and manual cell filters, see which cell types each removes, set bounds per sample, and score doublets
- [Highly variable genes](tutorials/feature-selection/): feature-set diagnostics
- [Dimensionality reduction](tutorials/dimensionality-reduction/): PCA dimensions and layout comparison
- [Neighborhood graph](tutorials/graph-construction/): build a PBMC graph stage by stage, check node degree and connected components, and compare neighbor counts and search depths
- [Clustering](tutorials/clustering/): Leiden resolutions, Paris cuts, membership strength, connectivity, and markers
- [Analysis reuse](tutorials/reuse-and-tracing/): change the neighbor count or number of PCs and reuse unchanged results, trace where analyses diverge, plan a recipe run, and read what each stage used

## Annotation, programs, and visualization

- [Cell type annotation](tutorials/annotation/): marker interpretation and label assignment
- [Gene-set scoring](tutorials/gene-set-scoring/): AUCell and WAGGR activity scores
- [Cell-cycle scoring](tutorials/cell-cycle/): S and G2M scores, phase assignment, marker coverage, the cycling populations of the embryonic mouse pancreas, and a comparison with the published scores
- [Regulons and gene programs](tutorials/regulons/): SCENIC regulons and their specificity, co-regulated gene programs, and chromVAR motif and CUT&RUN activity in a PBMC multiome sample
- [Visualization](tutorials/plotting/): colored embeddings, draw order, marker summaries, distributions, cluster composition, facets, saved and composed figures, and raster views of large datasets
- [Imputation](tutorials/imputation/): graph diffusion for exploratory visualization

## Chromatin and multimodal integration

- [scATAC-seq](tutorials/scatac-seq/): name the clusters of a saved PBMC run from gene scores of lineage markers, flag a doublet cluster by its peak counts, and run the ATAC recipe (cell filter, TF-IDF, LSI, Leiden) on your own peaks
- [CITE-seq](tutorials/cite-seq/): matched RNA and ADT analysis with WNN integration
- [TEA-seq](tutorials/tea-seq/): what RNA, ATAC, and protein each separate in the same PBMCs, three-way WNN integration, and each modality's WNN weight by cell type
- [WNN and SNN integration](tutorials/multimodal-diagnostics/): compare RNA, protein, WNN and SNN clusterings of the same cells, trace where they disagree, and inspect modality weights

## Integration, mapping, and donor comparisons

- [CyteBase composite datasets](tutorials/composite-datasets/): jointly analyze remote datasets, compare Harmony correction, and reopen saved results while counts stay in their sources
- [Dataset merging](tutorials/dataset-merging/): compatible stores and an uncorrected joint baseline
- [Harmony batch correction](tutorials/batch-correction/): Harmony2 batch correction, batch mixing and cell-type separation scores, and batch-aware gene selection
- [Reference mapping and label transfer](tutorials/mapping-and-label-transfer/): fixed-reference projection
- [Donor-level comparisons and pseudobulk](tutorials/condition-comparisons/): paired donor-level tests of matched conditions, and raw-count pseudobulk profiles exported with their design for differential expression

## Trajectories and fate mapping

- [Pseudotime and expression dynamics](tutorials/pseudotime/): supervised sources and sinks, genes correlated with pseudotime, and expression modules that catch transient genes
- [Fate mapping and potency](tutorials/fate-mapping/): multiple terminal outcomes, directed by a pseudotime or by potency scores without source cells
- [Lineage dynamics](tutorials/lineage-dynamics/): fate-weighted genes, branch points, drivers, and modules per lineage
- [Lineage curves and trajectory checks](tutorials/lineage-curves/): candidate sinks from a cluster tree, curves per lineage, placing points, and checks of scored cells, subgraph order, potency direction, cells off every curve, and branch points

## Lineage tracing and immune repertoires

- [Lineage tracing](tutorials/lineage-tracing/): LARRY's clones, clone sizes by day, fate coupling, the fate bias of day-2 progenitors, and fate probabilities scored against the fates their clones took
- [Lineage recorders](tutorials/lineage-recorders/): PEtracer marks of a mouse embryo at E7.5, its authors' clone trees, clones cut at five times from E5.0 to E7.0, and the coupling of cell types at each cut
- [Mitochondrial lineage tracing](tutorials/mitochondrial-lineage-tracing/): mgatk allele counts joined to a colorectal tumor's mtscATAC-seq cells, mitochondrial depth by cell type, informative variants and their confident carriers, clones called from the variants and shown on the ATAC embedding, and the coupling of cell types through shared clones
- [Immune repertoires](tutorials/immune-repertoires/): TCR and BCR contigs, chain checks against expression and doublets, clonotypes, clonal expansion, diversity and shared clonotypes of T cell types, MAIT gene usage, B cell clonal families, and AIRR export

## Perturbation screens

- [Pooled CRISPR screens](tutorials/crispr-screens/): guide calls, perturbation labels, target knockdown, E-distances, Mixscape escapers with protein checks, calibrated association tests and perturbation clusters in an ECCITE-seq screen

## Data management and interoperability

- [Import and export](tutorials/import-and-export/): convert 10x, Matrix Market, H5AD, CSV and in-memory counts with their UMAPs and labels, and export to Matrix Market, H5AD and Scanpy
- [Seurat import](tutorials/seurat-import/): selective RDS import, metadata notices, coordinate roles, and raw-count defaults
- [Scanpy users](scanpy/): workflow mapping and H5AD exchange
- [Seurat users](seurat/): workflow mapping, RDS import, and WNN differences
- [Data model comparison](scanpy-and-seurat/): how objects, selections, and saved results differ between tools
- [Cell and feature metadata](tutorials/data-organization/): cell and feature tables, saved run fields beside live columns, metadata selections, and the store layout
- [Provenance](concepts/provenance/): artifacts, reuse, lineage, and limits
- [Custom analyses](tutorials/custom-analyses/): per-cell statistics from a saved neighborhood graph and streamed count blocks, custom cell selections, and export to AnnData or a new store

## Public datasets

- [CyteBase datasets](tutorials/cytebase-datasets/): search the CyteBase catalog, build a dataset's URI, and open it read-only or as a writable mount

## Reference

- [Memory and execution](concepts/memory-and-execution/): choose budgets and workers, inspect run reports, and understand memory reservations
- [Remote storage configuration](reference/remote-storage/): object-store credentials, mount behavior, and scratch space for reductions
- [Methods and limitations](reference/methods/): supported workflows, implemented methods, validation evidence, and scope
- [FAQ](reference/faq/): concise method and interoperability answers
- [Glossary](reference/glossary/): CyteArc concepts and terms

## API reference

- [API overview](api/index.html): exact public signatures and result contracts
- [DataStore](api/datastore.html): open stores, select cells and features, run analyses, and access saved results
- [Analysis pipelines](api/pipeline.html): run the RNA, ATAC, ADT, multimodal, and CRISPR screen recipes, configure their stages, follow and cancel runs, inspect durable runs, and access frozen outputs
- [Graph construction](api/graph_construction.html): normalization, reduction, neighbor search, and connectivity stages
- [Reference mapping](api/mapping.html): build references, project query cells, and transfer labels
- [Integration and metrics](api/integration.html): WNN, SNN, Harmony2 batch correction and its parameters, and integration diagnostics
- [Assays and metadata](api/assays.html): assay types, count blocks, cell and feature metadata, and selections
- [Artifacts and lineage](api/artifacts.html): find saved results, trace their inputs, and summarize analyses
- [Import and export](api/import_export.html): readers, writers, dataset merging, and storage controls
- [Perturbation](api/perturbation.html): guide calls, perturbation labels, efficiency, E-distances, Mixscape, association tests, and perturbation profiles and clusters of pooled CRISPR screens, with their records
- [Clones](api/clones.html): import the clones that lineage tracing tools write or take them from a cell metadata column, join their cells to a store's cells by barcode, read them as a `Clones` record, and export them as clone tables or matrices
- [Plotting](api/plotting.html): embeddings, expression, clusters, trajectories, and diagnostics
- [Example datasets](api/datasets.html): list and download the public example datasets that the tutorials use
- [Utilities](api/utilities.html): store loading, computation settings, gene sets, logging, standard-library log forwarding, and progress
